verdict.rationale: Postmark supports event-driven automation via webhooks (delivery, bounce, open, click) that can trigger external actions on real-time events, and documents webhook payload validation/setup for building custom logic downstream. However, there is no native rule-definition engine inside Postmark itself (e.g., conditional triggers, multi-step workflows) — users must build the 'rule' logic in their own webhook receiver, and inbound 'bypass rules' are limited to blocking exceptions rather than general automation. Missing for 10: native conditional rule builder, in-product multi-action automation flows, and evidence of configurable trigger conditions beyond raw event delivery.
